none: PAS FindID 993813: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Urbs Roma commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17; possibly Trier mint issue of 333-334, if so, possibly RIC vol. 7 page 218 no. 562. Obverse description: Bust of Roma helmeted and mantled left, large eye and chin, object like two corn ears or feathers behind head. Obverse inscription: [VRBS ROMA]. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins, one star and one corn ear/feather above. Diameter: 14.3mm, Weight: 1.16gms, die axis: 12
